trigger.novel_question: whether Predict.fun pays deterministic monetary maker rebates capable of offsetting adverse-selection and inventory costs

question: Do the exact current official Predict.fun maker-rebate terms define a funded, deterministic, transferable monetary rebate with sufficient formula, eligibility, market scope, and disqualification conditions to justify finite-size after-cost testing?

endpoint_classification.operation: download one exact public official Predict.fun documentation page
endpoint_classification.source_contract: The retained bytes may establish only the current published maker-rebate terms on this exact page. They may not establish user eligibility, owned rewards, account access, execution quality, or profitability.

decision.advance: advance only if the page defines non-discretionary monetary rebate economics and exact market eligibility; then freeze a separate finite-size maker simulation charging trading fees, adverse selection, inventory, hedge, gas, latency, capital, account eligibility, and disqualification risk
decision.reject: terminalize current monetary-edge promotion if rebates are points, discretionary, temporary without an exact current schedule, account-unavailable, or economically unspecified

retry_policy: This exact official page GET is one-use. Preserve any shell, block, redirect, missing term, or unsupported content response. Do not try aliases, accounts, keys, sessions, claims, or state changes.
